objective: Determine the number of specified products that have zero available_today_quantity at the PowerTool shop by Praterstern in Vienna.

params.store: lookup from stores WHERE store_name = 'PowerTool shop by Praterstern' AND city = 'Vienna' returning store_id and record_path
products: lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Raaco' AND series = 'Raaco Professional CarryLite 3CS-7A9 Shelving and Cabinet' AND model = 'Shelving and Cabinet' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'storage type' AND property_value_text = 'stacking box') returning product_sku and record_path

lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Bahco' AND series = 'Bahco Comfort Grip BE 1ZR-PGS Pliers and Wrenches' AND model = 'Pliers and Wrenches' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'tool type' AND property_value_text = 'side cutter') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '125 mm') returning product_sku and record_path

lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Metabo' AND series = 'Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver' AND model = 'Cordless Drill Driver' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'voltage' AND property_value_text = '18 V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'battery platform' AND property_value_text = '18v-system') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'kit contents' AND property_value_text = 'case') returning product_sku and record_path

lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Bahco' AND series = 'Bahco Comfort Grip BE 1ZR-PGS Pliers and Wrenches' AND model = 'Pliers and Wrenches' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'tool type' AND property_value_text = 'side cutter') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '300 mm') returning product_sku and record_path

lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Geberit' AND series = 'Geberit Mapress Silent IC5-GU6 Valve and Connector' AND model = 'Valve and Connector' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'connector type' AND property_value_text = 'ball valve') returning product_sku and record_path

lookup from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Schneider Electric' AND series = 'Schneider Electric Heavy Duty Merten 214-ZHY Extension Cable' AND model = 'Extension Cable' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'color family' AND property_value_text = 'White') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '3 m') returning product_sku and record_path
params.count: for each product SKU found, query store_inventory WHERE store_id = $store.store_id AND product_sku = $product_sku AND available_today_quantity = 0; count the number of such products
